description_en: Queries the order list of a user or a reseller customer. By default, this operation queries orders created within the most recent hour. To query orders over a longer time range, set the CreateTimeStart and CreateTimeEnd parameters
description_zh: 查询用户或者分销客户订单列表情况。默认查询当前时间最近1小时范围内订单，如需查询更长时间范围的订单数据，请设CreateTimeStart和CreateTimeEnd参数
kebab_example: aliyun bssopenapi get-orders --create-time-end 2016-05-23T12:00:00Z --page-num 1 --page-size 20 --product-code rds --product-type rds --subscription-type Subscription --order-type New --payment-status Paid --create-time-start 2016-05-23T13:00:00Z --member-uid 1779628988149763 --api-version 2023-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetOrders
